## getChainAddresses() function

Returns the protocol address registry for a chain.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getChainAddresses: (chainId: number) => ChainAddresses
```

[ChainAddresses](./morpho-ts.chainaddresses.md)

## Exceptions

## Example


